scope: refuted non-Boolean entropy-versus-mean-cardinality route; prior known in September intake and arXiv:2606.00246v2 line 100
reproduction: q uniform on n singletons has H=log n and E|S|=1. If Boolean, the Fourier expansion sum_i a_i x_i has coefficient 2a_i a_j at {i,j} in f^2 for i!=j, contradicting f^2=1.
remaining_gap: Cannot infer FEI failure for Boolean functions; no novelty credit.

scope: every-coordinate restriction-increment bound fails for a particular coordinate in Boolean selector family; no global FEI counterexample
reproduction: Independently derived a_S=+/-2^{-n/2}, Fourier delta_y=2^{-n}, I_t=2^{-n}, Delta_t=n2^{-n}+L(2)/2-L(1). Since phi''(z)=(4 ln z+6)/ln 2>0 on [1/2,3/2], L is convex and Delta_t>=n I_t. Independent direct Walsh check: python -X utf8 verify_selector.py gave n=4 ratio 8.030013847 and n=6 ratio 10.255970235.
remaining_gap: An induction may choose a different coordinate; existence of a suitable coordinate is unproved.

scope: this selector family obeys H(F)<=2 I(F)
reproduction: Each core coordinate influence is 1/2+p and I_t=p; total n/2+(n+1)p. Chain rule for spectral t-membership gives H(F)<=n+h_2(p)<=n+2(n+1)p=2I(F) for p=2^{-n}, n>=4. Independent direct Walsh check gave H/I=1.800892435 at n=4 and 1.952643846 at n=6.
remaining_gap: Family result only; does not prove FEI for all Boolean functions.

scope: universal logarithmic local bound and sharp additive constant
reproduction: Independently checked Delta=JS_2(P,Q)+sum R h_2(q), sum Rq=p. The scalar inequality JS_e(P,Q)<=half squared Hellinger sum follows after u=|x-y|/(x+y) by comparing derivatives u/sqrt(1-u^2) and atanh(u), including endpoints. Signed coefficients satisfy (|a|-|b|)^2<=(a-b)^2, giving JS_2<=2p/ln2. The selector expansion L(u)=(3u^2-2u)p/ln2+O(p^{3/2}) uniformly for u in [0,2], hence Delta/p-log_2(1/p)->3/ln2; the upper bound matches.
remaining_gap: The bound contains log(1/p), so it cannot close FEI at arbitrarily small influences.

scope: conditional reduction to functions whose all influences are below a fixed tau
reproduction: At each node with I_i>=tau, C004 gives Delta_i<=[log_2(1/tau)+3/ln2]I_i. Dimension drops on each split. Apply the assumed low-influence FEI bound at leaves and the exact influence decomposition to induct with the maximum constant; converse is restriction of quantifiers.
remaining_gap: The uniform estimate for all-small-influence Boolean functions is an assumption, not established.

reproduction: For each child Fourier pair a,b, parent squared coefficients ((a+b)/2)^2 and ((a-b)/2)^2 have marginal R=(a^2+b^2)/2 and conditional selector probability q=(a-b)^2/[2(a^2+b^2)]. Finite entropy chain rule yields H(f)=H(R)+sum R h_2(q), then subtract average child entropy to obtain JS+B.
remaining_gap: Neither nonnegative term has a dimension-free global bound from this identity alone.

reproduction: Same scalar Jensen-Shannon/Hellinger inequality and signed coefficient comparison as w514-C004 give JS<=2 I_i/ln2; concavity gives B<=h_2(I_i). Checked all zero-mass cases by continuity.

reproduction: Bent pair product gives |ghat|=1/sqrt(N); point flip gives selector coefficient 1/N and selector influence 1/N. For each of N remaining indices R>=1/(2N), hence q<=2/N and B>=sum Rq log_2(N/2)=(m-1)/N. This is weaker than the independently checked w514-C002 bound.
remaining_gap: Other coordinates may give a good split; parent FEI untouched.

scope: bad selected coordinate persists when every physical influence is at most fixed tau
reproduction: Balanced disjoint majority gadgets have physical influence alpha and output uniform signs. Outer physical influence factorizes as alpha I_j(F). On the empty remaining-selector Fourier sector, restriction coefficients are c_U(Ahat(S)+/-alpha Bhat(S)); Parseval over active gadget sectors gives sum_U c_U^2=1 for each S. With |Ahat|>=1/(2sqrt(N)), q_U<=4alpha^2/N<=1/N. Thus this sector alone contributes B>=alpha^2 m/N, while I_v=alpha/N, yielding ratio>=alpha m. Independence is used only for disjoint blocks.
remaining_gap: It exhibits one bad coordinate, not all coordinates; no FEI counterexample.

text: For every Boolean f and every complete uniform restriction tree T with constant leaves, sum_v 2^{-depth(v)} B_v <= H(f) <= sum_v 2^{-depth(v)} B_v+(2/ln2)I(f). FEI is equivalent, up to that additive constant, to the existence of a uniform K such that for each f at least one such T has sum_v 2^{-depth(v)}B_v<=K I(f); if FEI holds the budget bound holds for every such T.
reproduction: Entropy and influence identities telescope exactly to H=sum_v w_v Delta_v and I=sum_v w_v I_i(v), then nodewise B<=Delta<=B+2I_i/ln2. The original phrase 'a dimension-free upper bound' leaves the tree quantifier unstated.
remaining_gap: No aggregate B estimate for arbitrary Boolean f is proved.

scope: special FEI<=4 family with all small influences and one bad coordinate
reproduction: For balanced disjoint gadget composition, active outer Fourier block S is uniquely identifiable; conditional product spectra give H(F(G))=H(F)+I(F)H(G), I(F(G))=I(F)I(G). Majority-of-three has H=2,I=3/2,leaf influence 1/2, so d iterates have beta=(3/2)^d, H=4(beta-1), alpha=2^{-d}. Outer selector has H<=m+1<=3I and I=m/2+(m+1)/2^m. Hence composition H/I<=4-1/beta<4. The L4 empty-selector-sector proof gives bad-coordinate ratio>=alpha m; choose fixed d for tau, then m large for M.
remaining_gap: This is a special family and blocks only an arbitrary-coordinate strategy.
